scope: Execution feasibility only; this is not production Banda vault code, a security audit, or current liquidity assurance.

simulation.taker: RobinhoodSwapTest deployed Solidity contract in local fork
simulation.funding: vm.deal seeds local native ETH; deployed WETH deposit creates WETH; deployed Uniswap swap obtains USDG. No ERC20 storage overrides or mainnet transactions.
assertions: Exact input balance debited; exact output balance delta equals router result and pre-swap quoter result
Both USDG-to-WETH-to-USDG and WETH-to-USDG-to-WETH contract-taker roundtrips execute
Missing allowance reverts without moving input or output balances
Impossible minimum output reverts without moving input or output balances
Approvals are exact amount and cleared after each successful leg
